_comment: The intersection operation set for the NoSQL shim's AWS DynamoDB frontend. See services/nosql/INTERSECTION.md for the per-cloud equivalence table and docs/phase-15-cd-scoping.md for the 15.C scoping. Tag ops round-trip the AWS-side identity for N3 (tags-vs-labels) but are not in the in-process intersection — they remain frontend-passthrough operations the backend translates per-cloud.
